definitions.gloss: rural area; county district; area outside incorporated cities
definitions.explanation: In Japanese administrative geography, the areas of a prefecture that lie outside incorporated cities ({市|し}). These are the towns ({町|まち}) and villages ({村|むら}) organized under county ({郡|ぐん}) groupings. Often used as a contrast to {市部|しぶ} (urban areas).

examples.japanese: {郡部|ぐんぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減少|げんしょう}している→減少する：19026_genshousuru⟧。
examples.english: The population in rural areas is declining.

examples.japanese: {市部|しぶ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{郡部|ぐんぶ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦スタイル→スタイル：03851_sutairu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: Lifestyles differ greatly between urban and rural areas.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{郡部|ぐんぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}→高齢者：15649_koureisha⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧になっている。
examples.english: In this prefecture, medical services for elderly people living in rural areas have become a challenge.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{郡|ぐん}→郡：03945_gun⟧ (county/district) + ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (area/section). In Japan's administrative system, prefectures are divided into ⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧ (cities) and ⟦{郡|ぐん}→郡：03945_gun⟧ (counties), with the counties containing ⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧ (towns) and ⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧ (villages).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {市部|しぶ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{郡部|ぐんぶ}: urban and rural areas
- {郡部|ぐんぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧: rural population
- {郡部|ぐんぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧: to live in a rural area
- {郡部|ぐんぶ}⟦{出身|しゅっしん}→出身：03221_shusshin⟧: from a rural area

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧: countryside; rural area — the everyday word, can be slightly condescending
- ⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧: provinces; regional area — broader, means anywhere outside major cities
- {市部|しぶ}: urban area; city districts — the direct opposite of {郡部|ぐんぶ}
- ⟦{僻地|へきち}→僻地：17059_hekichi⟧: remote area — more extreme, implies difficulty of access
